content.title: Antithrombotic therapy recommendations (excerpt)

recommendations.recommendation: Single oral antiplatelet agent for stroke prevention
recommendations.details: A single oral antiplatelet agent (preferably clopidogrel) for up to 12 months is recommended for stroke prevention.
During PCI, a UFH (unfractionated heparin) bolus is recommended in any of the following circumstances: if the patient is on a NOAC; if the INR is <2.5 in VKA‑treated patients.

recommendations.recommendation: Use of ticagrelor or prasugrel in triple therapy
recommendations.details: The use of ticagrelor or prasugrel as part of triple antithrombotic therapy is not recommended.

content.notes: This extract shows specific peri‑procedural recommendations and a contraindication for certain P2Y12 inhibitors when used as part of triple antithrombotic therapy.
